Anurag Singh of Ansid Capital highlights market resilience despite geopolitical tensions, noting a move beyond Iran concerns and a potential shift away from the 'Magnificent Seven' towards a more diversified rally.

Title: "Only consistent run-scoring can bring you back": Ishan Kishan on his comeback to Indian team
Synopsis: Ishan Kishan emphasized that consistent batting performances were key to his return to the Indian team after a period out. He focused on scoring runs rather than dwelling on disappointment, highlighting that selection hinges on performance. Kishan also shared insights from Sunrisers Hyderabad's win over Rajasthan Royals, including a chat with young Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.

Title: Iranian President Pezeshkian slams US over 'hypocritical' stance amid ceasefire extension
Synopsis: Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian has criticized the United States for what he calls hypocritical actions. This comes as US President Donald Trump announced an extension of a ceasefire with Iran. Trump stated the extension is to allow Iran time to present a unified proposal for negotiations.

Title: DoT releases revised guidelines for TDIP scheme to boost India's global telecom tech prowess
Synopsis: Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia launched revised guidelines for the Technology Development and Investment Promotion (TDIP) Scheme, allocating Rs 203 crore for 2026-31. The initiative aims to bolster India's role in global telecom standardization and foster indigenous technologies, including 5G Advanced and 6G, by supporting startups, MSMEs, academia, and industry players.

Title: Infosys set to discuss CEO transition for post Salil Parekh era
Synopsis: Infosys board members are set to discuss leadership changes. Current CEO Salil Parekh's term concludes soon. A two-year extension is anticipated to manage succession planning. This transition is crucial for maintaining stability amid industry disruptions. Investors are closely monitoring the situation for future leadership.

Title: Around 50 Israeli jets strike underground military bunker beneath Tehran leadership compound
Synopsis: The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) on Friday said that around 50 fighter jets of the country's Air Force carried out the strike targeting the underground military bunker linked to the late Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, which was used by other senior officials following his and other leaders' deaths last week.

Title: Who is Ayatollah Alireza Arafi? Meet the cleric helping steer Iran through war after Khamenei’s death
Synopsis: Ayatollah Alireza Arafi now leads Iran's interim council. He guides the nation through a war crisis and succession. Arafi, a hardline cleric, was chosen after Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's killing. He has strong ties to Khamenei and extensive experience in Iran's religious and political systems. His appointment is crucial for state stability.

Title: Why owning sector leaders could be a smarter core bet in 2026, Axis Mutual Fund’s Karthik Kumar explains
Synopsis: Axis Mutual Fund's Karthik Kumar highlights how their new Sector Leaders Index Fund addresses portfolio gaps by offering diversified exposure to top companies across 21 sectors. This rules-based approach aims to reduce concentration risk and capture leadership, providing a resilient core holding for investors navigating an earnings-led market in 2026.

Title: IMexI 2025 aligns shopfloor practices with India’s manufacturing push
Synopsis: The Integrated Manufacturing Excellence Initiative (IMexI) 2025 concluded in Mumbai, celebrating advancements in Indian manufacturing. The event highlighted best practices, leadership's role in driving change, and introduced the IMexI India Icon recognition, with Reliance Industries Limited's SEZ Refinery receiving the inaugural award. The initiative aims to foster sustained, enterprise-wide excellence.

Title: Trump reposts suggestion that Rubio become next Cuba leader
Synopsis: Trump republished a Truth Social message from user Cliff Smith, posted on January 8, that read "Marco Rubio will be president of Cuba," accompanied by a crying laughing emoji.

Title: Who is Todd Combs? Geico CEO leaves for JPMorgan, sparking buzz: Is Berkshire Hathaway ready for life after Buffett?
Synopsis: Todd Combs: Berkshire Hathaway sees major leadership shifts. Todd Combs, investment manager and Geico CEO, is leaving for JPMorgan Chase. Nancy Pierce takes over as Geico CEO. Marc Hamburg, CFO, will retire in 2027. Greg Abel is preparing to assume the CEO role in January. These changes signal Berkshire's evolution as Warren Buffett prepares to step aside.

Title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif 'intentionally' delaying Asim Munir's army promotion? Defence expert says so
Synopsis: Pakistan's military leadership is in flux. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's absence from the country has stalled a key notification for Field Marshal Asim Munir's new role. This has created a leadership vacuum at the top of the armed forces. The situation raises concerns about Pakistan's nuclear command authority.

Title: Ratan Tata death anniversary: 10 inspirational quotes that every entrepreneur and dreamer must read today
Synopsis: On October 9th, we honor Ratan Tata's enduring legacy with ten powerful quotes. His words emphasize resilience, decisiveness, and the importance of self-belief. Tata's philosophy highlights purpose-driven business, teamwork, and the courage to innovate, continuing to inspire leaders and entrepreneurs worldwide.

Title: EAM S Jaishankar’s ‘out of syllabus’ take on Donald Trump gains traction after Oval Office clash
Synopsis: A diplomatic firestorm erupted after a heated exchange between US President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in the Oval Office. As global leaders scrambled to make sense of the clash, an earlier remark by India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar resurfaced, striking a chord. His comment about India's need for "out of syllabus" foreign policy in response to Trump's unpredictable leadership gained fresh relevance.

Title: From the hockey rink to the boardroom: How Greg Abel skated his way to Berkshire Hathaway’s top spot
Synopsis: The longstanding question of who will succeed Warren Buffett as CEO of Berkshire Hathaway is now answered. Greg Abel, who has overseen Berkshire's vast energy and non-insurance businesses, has been confirmed as Buffett's heir. Abel’s rise within the company reflects his exceptional leadership, dedication to growth, and alignment with Buffett's values. As Buffett prepares for the future, Abel’s leadership will be key in navigating both opportunities and challenges in an evolving market landscape.

Title: The consulting firm betting on behaviour, not assumptions
Synopsis: Mouse & Cheese, a design intelligence and behavioral science consulting firm, was recognized as a 'Trendsetter to Watch' at the FUELD Conference in Dubai. The firm, founded in 2022, empowers organizations to reimagine growth through its 'Deconstruct and Evolve' framework, focusing on consumer psychology and attention scarcity.

Title: Quote of the day by Laozi: 'The wise man is one who knows what he does not know.'
Synopsis: Laozi, the legendary founder of Taoism, emphasized that true wisdom lies in recognizing the limits of one's knowledge. His philosophy encourages harmony with the natural flow of existence, advocating humility and curiosity over arrogance. This ancient teaching remains relevant today, urging us to embrace learning by admitting what we don't know.

Title: Why Alex Karp, the Jewish CEO of Palantir, says he ‘spends a lot of time talking to Nazis’, what is the reality?
Synopsis: Alex Karp on Nazis: Palantir CEO Alex Karp discussed his company's AI platform and his personal philosophy. He also made controversial remarks about talking to Nazis. Karp, who identifies as Jewish, is known for his unique views on politics and technology. His statements have drawn attention to his unconventional leadership style and Palantir's mission in national security and defense.

Title: After Rs 2 lakh crore selloff, FIIs are set for a comeback. Elara Capital lists 4 reasons
Synopsis: Elara Capital sees a potential FII turnaround in Indian equities, driven by under-ownership, narrowing valuation premiums, mid-cap resilience, GST cuts, and strong macro conditions, supporting gradual reallocation and domestic leadership.

Title: Meet Telegu superstar Mahesh Babu's niece who founded a company while still at college. Check educational qualifications of Anoushka Ranjit
Synopsis: Anoushka Ranjit, daughter of actress Shilpa Shirodkar and niece of Mahesh Babu, has charted an independent path away from the film industry. At just 22, she co-founded Pulse Creative Collective, a student-run company based in St Andrews, while pursuing a Master’s degree in International Relations and Modern History at the University of St Andrews. She is also studying law at the University of Law in London. With internships in Dubai and Hyderabad and leadership roles during her school years, Anoushka has established herself as a promising young entrepreneur and future legal professional.

Title: Elon Musk's days may be numbered with the Trump administration as his conflicts with cabinet members grow by the hour; here's the latest friction point
Synopsis: Elon Musk and the Trump administration are facing tensions. This is regarding leadership changes at the IRS. Trump appointed Gary Shapley as acting head. This happened without Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's knowledge. Bessent then replaced Gavin Kliger, a Musk ally. Michael Faulkender is now the acting head. He is the fifth person in the role since January.

Title: Mind Over Money: 36-hour fasting for the mind and body: A CEO’s secret to sustained energy
Synopsis: Ventura CEO Hemant Majethia embraces a 36-hour weekly fast for peak performance, balancing physical detox with mental clarity. His love for books, especially history and business narratives, shapes his leadership, strategic insights, and decision-making approach.

Title: US says kills 'key' Houthi leaders in Yemen strikes
Synopsis: The U.S. military has conducted strikes in Yemen, targeting key Houthi leadership, including their top missile specialist. This campaign, initiated in response to Houthi threats against Red Sea shipping, has also impacted the group's headquarters, communications, weapons factories, and drone production sites, according to National Security Adviser Mike Waltz.

Title: RSS on global outreach to clear misconceptions about it: Hosabale
Synopsis: RSS General Secretary Dattatreya Hosabale is engaging with intellectuals and academics in the US and UK. He aims to clarify the organization's objectives and address decades of misconceptions. Hosabale is highlighting the RSS's focus on social harmony and shedding colonial mindsets. He believes Prime Minister Narendra Modi embodies RSS values.

Title: 'Sorry for misleading people': Tucker Carlson expresses regret over Trump endorsement
Synopsis: Conservative commentator Tucker Carlson has voiced regret over his past support for Donald Trump. He stated he is sorry for misleading people during Trump's presidential campaign. Carlson's remarks signal a shift from his earlier influential role as a Trump ally. This development has sparked debate, with some viewing it as an honest reassessment and others as a strategic move.

Title: Iran has limited the impact of US strikes, intelligence says
Synopsis: Western intelligence suggests Iran's military planning helped it survive US-Israeli attacks. Despite significant damage and leader deaths, Iran's missile and drone forces remain operational. The country has decentralized decision-making and is preparing for potential future conflict. This contrasts with US claims of complete military destruction. Iran's resilience poses a challenge to US objectives.

Title: Sun Enters Aries Igniting Career Growth, Confidence & New Opportunities For These 3 Zodiac Signs
Synopsis: Sun entering Aries on March 20, 2026, triggers a powerful shift in career growth, confidence, and new opportunities. Aries season brings fast-moving energy, encouraging bold decisions, leadership, and fresh starts. While all zodiac signs feel the impact, Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius may experience sudden breakthroughs, making this a crucial time to act wisely and avoid impulsive mistakes.

Title: Two Congress leaders join BJP ahead of Kerala polls
Synopsis: Two Congress leaders, B.S. Anoop and R.S. Arun Raj, joined the BJP in Thiruvananthapuram, expressing dissatisfaction with the Congress leadership. Both leaders, denied tickets for the upcoming Assembly elections, are expected to contest from Chirayinkeezhu and Chadayamangalam respectively. BJP state president Rajeev Chandrasekhar welcomed them, stating that sincere workers cannot grow in the Congress.

Title: Dhoni must bat no lower than number six, or step aside: AB de Villiers
Synopsis: AB de Villiers has proposed that MS Dhoni should elevate his batting position within the Chennai Super Kings lineup. On another note, Anil Kumble has endorsed the idea of integrating Sanju Samson into the team's leadership structure, praising his stellar form and rapport with supporters.

Title: Use tech to hone skills, improve potential: PM Narendra Modi to students
Synopsis: The prime minister urged students not to be afraid of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, but use them to hone their skills and improve potential. The prime minister also urged students to practice previous papers and have a good sleep to perform better in examinations.

Title: Tata Trusts put faith in N Chandrasekaran for another term to sustain growth
Synopsis: Tata Trusts has unanimously approved a five-year extension for N Chandrasekaran as chairman of Tata Sons, signaling leadership continuity. This decision occurs amidst strategic considerations to maintain Tata Sons' private status and potential discussions with the Shapoorji Pallonji Group for their exit.
